status: Qualified native fused EXL3 expert component; full inference and parity goal remains active

implementation.arithmetic: Source fused up/gate/SiLU/down with F16 intermediate boundaries and route weight folded into final Hadamard scale; weighted F32 assignment slots followed by source ordered reduction.
implementation.width_requirement: Pin full-tier source group width across residency windows; changing width changes rounding. Width8 versus16 differs in38/44 basic source frames.
implementation.ownership: Immutable borrowed expert handles; request-private scratch and barriers; existing GPU cache reserves before upload and keeps leases until both requests finish. No GPU handles added to model weights.
implementation.execution: Cooperative launch ensures co-residency for group barriers; by-value bounded pointer table; validation precedes launch. Execution callback performs no allocation, copy, or host synchronization.

references.actual_weights: Two actual expert triples, layer0 expert0 and layer39 expert383, D5120 H2304; other weights synthetic. Real router metadata included separately.
references.policy: Independent unchanged original normal/cooperative kernels captured before candidate runs; original weighted slots and ordered final outputs preserved.

race_fix.finding: Shared warp transpose scratch could be reused before every lane completed its reads.
race_fix.upstream_reproduction: Unchanged original kernel reports the same hazard in racecheck-original.log.
race_fix.native_fix: Post-read __syncwarp in had_hf_r_128_d_inner. Floating point arithmetic unchanged; original goldens unchanged.
race_fix.final_result: Focused10-fixture racecheck: zero hazards, errors and warnings; all source byte comparisons exact.
race_fix.prior_results: Preserved in before-warp-reuse-fix; superseded by final qualification.

full.scope: Warmed resident execution only; setup, cache window changes, readback and driver synchronization are outside capture. Durations are diagnostic, not a full MoE or vLLM comparison.

bounded.scope: Warmed resident execution only; setup, cache window changes, readback and driver synchronization are outside capture. Durations are diagnostic, not a full MoE or vLLM comparison.

limits: Native full-model forward, generation and CLI admission remain absent.
The source small-batch <=8 specialized decode profile is not ported by this component.
Production model-aware RAM/VRAM async IO, complete fused/folded/shared FFN composition, attention and Engram execution remain future work.
Cache-window probe synchronizes explicitly between windows; it proves ownership and correctness, not asynchronous offload throughput.
Pointer table currently supports at most32 resident experts per launch; fully resident384-expert fast path remains future performance work.
Maximum staging-one-projection reports payload size, not total physical host peak.
No full-model or matched vLLM performance claim.
